findings.summary: Unhandled promise rejection in ProcessPrReviewComments.execute when contextSource throws, which crashes the orchestrator agent run loop
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap `await d.contextSource!(...)` and `selectPrReviewContext(...)` in a try/catch block. If an error occurs, either fall back to `forceNoBatch = true` or mark the batch as failed with a retry disposition of "split".

findings.summary: The seedPaths argument for contextSource uses all comment paths from the original manifest instead of filtering to only those currently pending
findings.suggested_fix: Use `currentBatchComments.map(c => c.path)` instead of `batch.comments.map(c => c.path)` for seedPaths so that already-resolved comments do not needlessly pull in extra context.
